<!--
  Dashboard counters in a row or a grid: tiles with an icon, a number and a caption, or compact figures. Axes:
  columns (2, 4), item (tile, compact), tone (default, muted), density (default, compact).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Metric } from "./metric-row.types";

  export type MetricRowProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    metrics: Metric[];
    empty?: string;
    cols?: "2" | "4";
    item?: "tile" | "compact";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import StatTile from "../components/stat-tile.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    metrics,
    empty = "",
    cols = "4",
    item = "tile",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: MetricRowProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((metrics?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="gauge" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Grid cols={(((cols as string) === "2") ? "1-2" : "1-4")} class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      {#each metrics as m (m.id)}
        {#if ((item as string) === "tile")}
          <Box data-testid="item">
            <StatTile label={m.label} value={m.value} icon={m.icon} hint={m.hint} />
          </Box>
        {:else}
          <Stack gap="0" class="rounded bg-card p-4 inset-ring inset-ring-border" data-testid="item">
            <Group gap="2" align="center" class="text-muted-foreground">
              <LucideIcon name={m.icon} size={16} />
              <Text size="xs">
                {m.label}
              </Text>
            </Group>
            <Text size="2xl" weight="bold">
              {m.value}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {m.hint}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        {/if}
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
